summary: Complete testing of LUIGGI HOME Despiece (Bill of Materials) feature and width display correction. All 8 requested features verified and working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Despiece feature fully implemented. API endpoint: POST /api/despiece/calculate. Modal has two views: 'Orden de Montaje' and 'Lista de Corte'. Width values correctly displayed in cm (divided by 10 from mm storage).

width_display_library.details: Width in product library shows 40 (cm) instead of 400 (mm). Correctly divided by 10. Verified in BudgetTable.jsx line 727: Math.round(p.width / 10)

width_display_budget_table.details: Width in budget table shows 40 (cm). Input value correctly displays cm. Verified in BudgetTable.jsx lines 601-602: Math.round(item.customWidth / 10)

despiece_button_visible.details: DESPIECE button (orange, with scissors icon) visible in toolbar. Has data-testid='despiece-btn'. Only visible for users with canViewTechnicalDespiece permission.

despiece_modal_opens.details: Modal opens with title 'SISTEMA DE DESPIECE - Orden de Montaje y Lista de Corte'. Shows summary banner with Muebles, Piezas Totales, Área Total, Material Armazón.

despiece_api_endpoint.details: POST /api/despiece/calculate returns correct response with items array, each containing components (TAPA SUPERIOR, TAPA INFERIOR, LATERALES, TRASERA, BALDAS), totalPanels, totalArea, and summary with byMaterial breakdown.

orden_montaje_view.details: 'Orden de Montaje' view shows expandable furniture items with component table. Columns: COMPONENTE, CÓDIGO, MATERIAL, ANCHO (MM), ALTO (MM), CANT., NOTAS. Components include: TAPA-S, TRAV-I, LAT-I, LAT-D, TRAS, BALDA.

lista_corte_view.details: 'Lista de Corte' view shows flat list of all pieces to cut. Columns: #, Mueble, Pieza, Material, Largo (mm), Ancho (mm), Cantidad, Cantos.

menu_order_sidebar.details: Sidebar menu order is correct: CRM > PRESUPUESTO > IA LAB > ARCHIVO > COPIA SEGURIDAD > MASTER > SALIR

ui_verification.library_width_column: Shows width in cm (40, 45, 50, etc.) - correctly divided by 10
ui_verification.budget_table_width_input: Shows width in cm with editable input
ui_verification.despiece_button: Orange button with scissors icon, text 'DESPIECE'
ui_verification.despiece_modal_header: Dark indigo header with 'SISTEMA DE DESPIECE' title
ui_verification.view_tabs: Two tabs: 'ORDEN DE MONTAJE' (active by default) and 'LISTA DE CORTE'
ui_verification.summary_banner: Shows Muebles count, Piezas Totales, Área Total (m²), Material Armazón
ui_verification.material_summary: Shows breakdown by material with piece count and area
ui_verification.component_table: Editable width/height inputs for each component
